english_fact_card.reader_value: The site remains sealed off and uncleaned, with potential ongoing health risks. The government has warned people never to enter the site.
english_fact_card.reader_action: Avoid the sealed-off site on Bolton House Road. Report any concerns to the Environment Agency or local authorities.
